entry.description: bound the queue `RemoteSyslogAppender` sends from. It was unbounded, so a syslog server that stopped accepting datagrams grew it until the process ran out of memory, and shutdown waited five seconds and then abandoned a drain that had no limit of its own. It now holds `sendQueueSize` datagrams (500), a logging call waits at most `enqueueTimeoutMillis` (5000) for room, losses are counted and reported, and `Flush` honours its timeout (audit da18b6fd-f034, implemented by @FreeAndNil)
